items.title: OJS 3 CSS Template - Minimalist Theme
items.description: A minimalist CSS template for Open Journal Systems 3, designed for academic journals seeking a clean and modern look. This template focuses on simplicity and readability, making it ideal for scholarly publications. It includes responsive design, customizable color schemes, and support for all OJS 3 features.

items.title: OJS 3 CSS Template - Modern Theme
items.description: A modern CSS template for Open Journal Systems 3, designed for academic journals seeking a contemporary and visually engaging look. This template features a sleek design with bold typography, customizable color schemes, and support for all OJS 3 features. It is perfect for scholarly publications that want to make a strong visual impact while maintaining readability.
